controlled_negotiation_probes.wrapper_source:
#!/usr/bin/bash
args=()
previous=''
for argument in "$@"; do
  if [[ "$previous" == '-avoid_negative_ts' && "$argument" == 'disabled' ]]; then
    args+=('make_zero')
  else
    args+=("$argument")
  fi
  previous="$argument"
done
exec /usr/lib/jellyfin-ffmpeg/ffmpeg-j0-original "${args[@]}"
